mapper.sql: achievement.achievement_id, achievement.management_no, achievement.teacher_user_id, teacher.login_id AS teacher_name, achievement.evaluation_year, achievement.management_item_code, achievement.achievement_date, detail.performance_content, detail.academic_year, detail.semester_code, achievement.attachment_ids::text AS attachment_ids, achievement.achievement_status, achievement.created_at, achievement.updated_at

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings requester_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = requester_mapping.organization_code WHERE requester_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND requester_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings permission_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = permission_mapping.organization_code WHERE permission_mapping.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND permission_mapping.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND permission_mapping.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements achievement WHERE achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT
FROM education_achievements achievement JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details detail ON detail.achievement_id = achievement.achievement_id JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = achievement.teacher_user_id WHERE achievement.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement.achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND achievement.deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievements ( management_no, achievement_type, teacher_user_id, organization_code, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_date, attachment_ids, achievement_status, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT #{command.managementNo}, 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT', #{command.teacherUserId}, mapping.organization_code, #{command.evaluationYear}, #{command.managementItemCode}, #{command.achievementDate}, CAST(#{command.attachmentIds} AS jsonb), 'DRAFT', 'N', #{command.createdBy}, #{command.createdBy} FROM organization_user_mappings mapping WHERE mapping.user_id = #{command.teacherUserId} AND mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY mapping.organization_code LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO lecture_improvement_achievement_details ( achievement_id, performance_content, academic_year, semester_code ) VALUES ( #{achievementId}, #{achievementContent}, #{academicYear}, #{semesterCode} )
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, reason_code, opinion, processed_by, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{history.achievementType}, #{history.achievementId}, #{history.previousStatus}, #{history.nextStatus}, #{history.actionType}, #{history.reasonCode}, #{history.opinion}, #{history.processedBy}, #{history.processedAt} )

INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason ) VALUES ( #{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason} )
